source.rationale: isDateLike has to recognise a date however the CRM wrote it, because anything it misses becomes a dym entry that a later date reply can hijack. Three forms are offered here — unpadded ISO (2026-8-5), slash ISO (2026/08/05) and day-first (5/8/26) — alongside one real code. Only the code may reach dym_candidates; all four stay in the roster and the buttons, which is where the customer needs them.
